summary.name: FantasyGF
summary.one_liner: FantasyGF is an adult-oriented AI girlfriend website and app where users create a custom virtual companion and chat with her, receive images, voice, and video.
use_cases: creating a custom AI companion character
summary.what_it_does: The site lets users design an AI girlfriend by choosing appearance and personality traits, then chat with her in text. The page says the character learns preferences from conversations and that users can request selfies or other images in chat or generate images through prompts. It also mentions voice and short video features. The page states the service offers uncensored and adult (18+) content. Much of the page is promotional copy and does not describe specific technical details or pricing.
notable: Customizable AI girlfriend appearance and personality, with a builder page
Image, voice, and 5-second video generation via chat or prompts
caveats: Adult-only (18+) explicit content; not suitable for minors
Premium tier exists (page shows 'Get Premium'); free allowance described as 5 AI girlfriends per month, with details of limits unclear
Page is heavily promotional; specific features and privacy claims are not independently verified
